prompt: This is a satellite or aerial remote-sensing image. Locate every individual instance belonging to these categories: airplane, bridge, storage-tank, ship, swimming-pool, vehicle, person, wind-mill. Pay attention to tiny objects, especially vehicles and people. Draw a tight box around each individual object; do not combine nearby objects into one box. Use only the exact category names above. Return only a JSON array of {"bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "label": "category"}. Coordinates must be normalized to 0-1000 relative to this image, in top-left to bottom-right order. Return [] if no target is visible.
